nodes.title: Start
nodes.content:
I am the Data Keeper, guardian of ancient knowledge.

# What is your purpose here?

nodes.title: signal_fragments
nodes.content:
The signal fragments are scattered across the northern spires.

Collect three purple shards to restore the signal.

# Do you understand?

nodes.title: place_info
nodes.content:
This planet was once a hub of interstellar communication.

Now only echoes remain, waiting for a messenger to restore the signal.

# What else would you like to know?

nodes.title: understood
nodes.content:
Good. The fragments glow with a purplish light.

Trust your instincts, messenger.

-> END

nodes.title: farewell
nodes.content:
May your path be clear and your signal strong.

-> END
